title: SOLICITATION NUMBER 385466, “Advance Modular Pretreatment System (AMPS)”
agency_path: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.HANFORD TANK WASTE OPERATIONS & CLOSURE LLC - DOE CONTRACTOR
detail_text: Hanford Tank Waste Operations & Closure LLC (H2C) requests proposals for the solicitation identified above. The requested work is in support of H2C’s Prime Contract Prime Contract 89303324DEM000096 (Integrated Tank Disposal Contract (ITDC)) with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), Hanford Field Office (HFO). This solicitation includes specific evaluation criteria which will form the basis for award of a Blanket Master Agreement (BMA).
